90% Means:

  • Forecasting – customer commitment/contract signed
  • Opportunity added to revenue forecast
  • Procurement begins to order inventory for opportunity

90% Requirements

  • Go-live date


100% = First order confirmed via PO or tracings
First contact was made with proper representative.
Possibility of new opportunity was spotted.

70% Indicates:

  • Clinical trial period, contraction negotiation and finalization of usage
  • Receiving positive feedback, nearing commitment

80% Initiates:

  • Stock reservation
  • BU’s and procurement conduct analysis to ensure Sol-M can support conversion

Requirements at 80%:

  • Usage file (as attachment)
  • Task created for Raj
  • Pricing
  • Target conversion date
  • Distributor
